title: Fun Short School Stories for Children with Steve and Maggie | Learn the Senses  | English for Kids
description:
🎒 Join Steve and Maggie for a fun-packed adventure with super-sized school objects and the senses! In this collection of short, simple sketches, Steve introduces and practises new vocabulary in his signature silly, creative way. Expect big reactions, magic surprises, and playful conflicts — all designed to tap into children’s emotional memory and make learning truly stick.

✏️ Includes:
·       Repetitive, interactive pronunciation practice
·       Printed-word support to build early reading skills
·       Lots of laughter, language development, and magical moments

Let’s learn and play with Steve and Maggie!
